title: Adaptive RBAC Intake Engine for Customer Onboarding and Org-Policy Normalization
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers routinely submit admin/access requests (RBAC role templates, SSO/SAML onboarding, SCIM provisioning adjustments, org-level policy exceptions). Current intake is manual and inconsistent: triage takes too long, requests are misrouted between Support/SE/Platform, and customers receive divergent guidance across touchpoints.

Goal: Ship an 'Adaptive RBAC Intake Engine' that standardizes incoming admin/access requests into structured tickets with: intent labels (RBAC change, SSO onboarding, SCIM schema change, org-policy exception), priority score (based on org size, SLA, data-sensitivity), recommended routing (Support/SE/Product/Eng), and a suggested prescriptive action (RBAC template, SSO check-list, SCIM patch snippet, or rollout playbook). The engine will also surface gaps (missing audit logs, missing IdP metadata) and attach a reproducible checklist to accelerate handling.

Scope: MVP covers non-bug admin/access requests from self-serve and support channels. It will include heuristics + lightweight ML classifier, rule-based normalization for SAML/SCIM fields, and an authoring interface for PM/SE to tune templates. Excludes on-prem upgrade mechanics, long-lived entitlement provisioning flows, and automated privileged credential issuance (handled by a later project).
acceptance_criteria: Classifier correctly labels request intent with >=88% precision on a withheld validation set of 1,200 historical tickets
Average triage time reduced from 18h to <=4h for tagged admin/access requests in pilot orgs
Suggested routing matches final owner in >=92% of pilot cases
Engine attaches at least one actionable artifact (RBAC template, SSO checklist, or SCIM patch) for 75% of classified requests
Rollout runbook documented and validated with Support, SE, and Platform teams
technical_considerations: Data sources: historical Linear tickets (10k admin/access subset), Support CSVs, Slack intake threads; need PII review and redaction before model training

Model: start with a lightweight transformer (fine-tune DistilBERT) for intent classification + rule-based extractor for SAML/SCIM fields to produce normalized attributes (IdP entityID, ACS URLs, SCIM schema names)
Runtime: classification happens at intake (Support form webhook + email parser + linear import); must return labels within 200ms for webflow UX; async enrichment acceptable for slower channels
RBAC templates: parametric templates (role_name, allowed_endpoints, privileged_scope) stored in Console config; require UI surface for SE/PM to create templates without Eng deploy
Audit and compliance: every classified ticket must log classifier version, ruleset id, and decision metadata for post-hoc review
Security: classifier and enrichment jobs run in a restricted project with KMS access audited; any attached artifacts containing credentials are forbidden
Edge cases: multi-intent requests (SSO + RBAC change) should generate a multi-label outcome and split sub-issues; ambiguous requests should escalate to human triage with pre-filled checklist
rollout_plan: Week 0-2: Data collection and redaction; secure approval for training dataset from Legal/Privacy
Week 3-4: Prototype classifier + rule-based extractor; internal perf benchmark on 1.2k holdout set
Week 5: Author RBAC template library and SSO/SCIM checklists with SE and Compliance
Week 6: Integrate with Support form webhook and test low-volume pilot (3 existing customers) in staging
Week 7-8: Run pilot, collect metrics, tune thresholds; update runbook; train Support and SE on new triage UX
Week 9: Expand to 20 customers, add Linear automation to auto-assign and create recommended sub-issues
Week 10: Full enabled rollout for self-serve inbound channel; gradual enable for Support email channel with human-in-loop approval
Post-launch: Monthly review cadence; model retrain every 8 weeks or on concept drift detection
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Classifier mislabels high-risk requests leading to delayed remediation. Mitigation: conservative thresholds for high-impact orgs (force human approval) and audit trail for every decision.
Risk: Exposure of sensitive IdP metadata in ticket text. Mitigation: automatic redaction rules + deny-list for credential patterns + compliance review before pilot.
Risk: Too many false positives for multi-intent detection. Mitigation: create structured sub-issue workflow and UI affordances for splitting requests.
Risk: SE/Support adoption friction. Mitigation: build concise triage UI, provide migration training, and offer rollback toggles per workspace
estimated_metrics: Target mean time to triage: <=4 hours for pilot orgs
Target reduction in cycle time to resolution for admin/access requests: 30% at 3 months
Operational SLO: enrichment job error rate <0.5%
